headerDisplay: A Homebridge plugin for checking for updates to Homebridge and plugins.

name.title: Name
name.description: A unique name for the accessory. It will be used as the accessory name in HomeKit. Can only contain letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens, and underscores. Periods and other special characters are not allowed as they can cause HomeKit pairing issues.

sensorType.title: Sensor Type
sensorType.description: What type of sensor will be exposed to HomeKit.

checkHomebridgeUpdates.title: Check for Homebridge updates
checkHomebridgeUpdates.description: Check if an update is available for the Homebridge server

checkHomebridgeUIUpdates.title: Check for Homebridge Config UI updates
checkHomebridgeUIUpdates.description: Check if an update is available for the Homebridge UI

checkPluginUpdates.title: Check for plugin updates
checkPluginUpdates.description: Check if updates are available for any installed plugins

checkDockerUpdates.title: Check for Docker image updates
checkDockerUpdates.description: Check if Docker image updates are available (ignored if not running in Docker container)

forceNcu.title: Force npm-check-updates
forceNcu.description: Force use of node-check-updates instead of homebridge-config-ui-x

autoUpdateHomebridge.title: Auto-update Homebridge
autoUpdateHomebridge.description: Automatically install Homebridge updates when available (requires homebridge-config-ui-x and sufficient npm privileges)

autoUpdateHomebridgeUI.title: Auto-update Homebridge Config UI
autoUpdateHomebridgeUI.description: Automatically install Homebridge Config UI updates when available (requires homebridge-config-ui-x and sufficient npm privileges)

autoUpdatePlugins.title: Auto-update plugins
autoUpdatePlugins.description: Automatically install plugin updates when available (requires homebridge-config-ui-x and sufficient npm privileges)

allowDirectNpmUpdates.title: Allow direct npm updates
allowDirectNpmUpdates.description: Allow automatic updates using direct npm commands even when homebridge-config-ui-x is not available (requires sufficient npm privileges)

autoRestartAfterUpdates.title: Auto-restart after updates
autoRestartAfterUpdates.description: Automatically restart Homebridge after successful automatic updates to apply changes

failureSensorType.title: Failure Sensor Type
failureSensorType.description: What type of sensor will be used for update/restart failure notifications (only shown when auto-updates are enabled).
